<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/node/{hostname}/interface"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Reads each interface but the loopback, in the order of its index: /sys/class/net and ip on Linux, ifconfig and netstat on macOS. dhcp4 is true when a route of the interface has proto dhcp, and primary when it has the default route.
